name: random_joke
description: Fetch one random Chuck Norris joke from chucknorris.io. Returns joke text, unique ID, category list, and permalink URL.

name: search_jokes
description: Search Chuck Norris jokes by keyword. Returns matching jokes with text and IDs.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for within joke text.

name: list_categories
description: List all available Chuck Norris joke categories (e.g., 'nerdy', 'sport'). Use with joke_by_category to fetch jokes.

name: joke_by_category
description: Get a random Chuck Norris joke from a specific category. Returns joke text and ID.

category.description: Category to fetch a joke from. Use list_categories to see valid values.
